title: Fixed Inward Groove Arch and Split Table Banding Unit
description: One newly authored complete fixed arch-strapping-table-style exterior. A full low rectangular cabinet on four broad feet supports two distinct empty tabletop halves separated by one real narrow transverse centre slot. One complete thin-depth tall U arch rises from both side roots, with continuous thick outer webs and front/rear inner lips defining a visible inward-facing groove along both uprights and the top span. A full side-mounted opaque annular supply-band roll sits between two entire bored retaining flanges on one continuous shaft and rooted mount. A small closed lower transition cover and blank front controls belong to the same cabinet. Unlike the old pallet stretch wrapper there is no floor turntable/tall side mast/vertical travelling roll, and unlike the baggage unit there is no deep tunnel, long belt or extended conveyor legs. The thin channel arch, table-slot relationship and side spool are newly authored together, not old parts assembled or resized. One whole model zero scenes; three opaque solid PBR roles. Empty static exterior only, no package or routed band, true multiple layers, feed circuit, tension, sealing, cutting, motor, movement, load, operating instruction or packaging/safety capability. Rigging animation interaction not made.
